page.overview:
What is 1 Yarbro Court?

Actress Lindsay McCabe moved from Los Angeles into the apartment building after being accepted into the San Francisco Repertory Theater, along with her cat, Casey). Since the place was too big for Lindsay and Casey alone, and she didn't know anyone else in San Francisco yet, Lindsay convinced her supposedly unemployed best friend Jessica Drew to be her roommate, with the idea that she might find work in another city.

At their housewarming party, David introduced himself to Jessica, giving her a bonsai tree that happened to have a spider on it, which she thought was cute, and he later took Jessica around the garden during the party. While they were immediately attracted to each other, David massaged Jessica's sore shoulder and they kissed; but she left abruptly to investigate an alarm as Spider-Woman, disappearing when David left for a moment. After facing Black Tom Cassidy and Juggernaut, with his new ally Siryn), she escaped and returned home. The X-Men meanwhile tracked Spider-Woman to the building and recognized it. One of them, Angel, was in his civilian identity a member of the board of directors of the San Francisco Repertory Theater, and used his influence with guest Ben Disraeli to crash the party with his friends, secretly the X-Men. The X-Men approached Jessica for friendly questioning and discovered their enemies' activity, and after that Jessica left the party with the X-Men to collaborate with them against the same threat.

Later, as a private investigator, Jessica was hired by Pamela Kramer, a law student who wanted to find her missing father Michael. Pamela was being targeted by agents of the supercriminal Viper, also interested in finding Michael. To protect Pamela, Jessica decided to hide her in her private residence at 1 Yarbro Court from that very night. When Lindsay woke up the next day, Jessica convinced her to stay home to keep an eye on Pamela. Investigating further, Spider-Woman asked Detective Morrell to come to 1 Yarbro Court to assist. Then, Viper arrived and attacked in an attempt to kidnap Pamela but, after a fight with Morrell, fled the scene.

When Jessica later arrived with Michael, she found her house in disarray from Viper's attack, with furniture broken; but the phone was still working. Jessica discovered that Lindsay was in the hospital, and met with her emotionally, revealing her secret identity. Jessica was very angry with Viper and also with Morrel for not adequately protecting Lindsay. After tracking Viper, Jessica visited David, kissed him, confirmed that Lindsay would recover, had tea with him, and then asked for his motorcycle to track Viper. David worried about her because it was dangerous, even crying when she left, but agreed, even giving her protective leather clothing.
